create_schulze_ranking: create a Schulze social ranking from citizen preference rankings using the Schulze method
aggregate_schulze_method: aggregate citizen rankings into a single social ranking with potential ties using Schulze pairwise defeats
compute_pairwise_defeats: compute pairwise defeats between candidates from batched citizen rankings
compute_strongest_path_strengths: compute strongest path strengths between all candidate pairs using the Schulze algorithm
rank_candidates_schulze: rank candidates by their pairwise weak preference dominance derived from Schulze path strengths
